davomat.team.description: Everyone the terminals know: their photo, job, location and where they are today.
davomat.team.empty.title: No employees yet
davomat.team.empty.body: Add people one by one, import a list from Excel, or simply let them scan: a face the terminal knows but this list doesn’t becomes an employee by itself.
davomat.team.col.name: Employee
davomat.team.face.label: Face ID numbers
davomat.team.face.placeholder: Number from the terminal, then Enter
davomat.team.face.invalid: Only letters, digits, - and _, up to 32 characters.
davomat.team.form.photoHint: A clear face photo helps everyone recognize them in the feed.
davomat.team.form.branchesHint: Where they work: their scans and reports count there.
davomat.team.form.scheduleHint: Lateness and absences are counted against it.
davomat.team.form.faceHint: The Employee No. this person has on the terminal. Several terminals may know them under different numbers: add each one.
davomat.team.photo.title: Crop the photo
davomat.team.photo.hint: Drag the photo and zoom so the face fills the circle.
davomat.team.photo.failed: This image can’t be opened. Try a JPEG or PNG.
davomat.team.photo.pending: The new photo is saved with the employee.
davomat.team.leave.title: {name} leaves the company
davomat.team.leave.description: From this day their scans no longer count. Their history stays, and you can bring them back later.
davomat.team.return.title: Bring {name} back?
davomat.team.return.body: Their scans count again from today, with their old numbers and history.
davomat.team.import.title: Import employees
davomat.team.import.description: From a CSV or Excel file. Nothing changes until you press Import: first you see what each row will do.
davomat.team.import.dropHint: CSV or XLSX, up to 5 MB, one employee per row
davomat.team.import.columnsHint: The first row holds the column names; only a first name (or full name) column is required.
davomat.team.import.toUpdate: {n} to update | {n} to update | {n} to update
davomat.team.import.withErrors: {n} with errors | {n} with an error | {n} with errors
davomat.team.import.name: Name
davomat.team.import.errorsHint: Rows with errors are skipped. Fix them in the file and drop it again.
davomat.team.import.confirm: Import {n} employees | Import {n} employee | Import {n} employees
davomat.team.import.failed: The file couldn’t be read. Check that it is a CSV or XLSX with a header row.
davomat.employee.notFound.title: This employee isn’t here
davomat.employee.notFound.body: They may have been removed, or they work at a location you don’t see.
davomat.employee.month.title: Attendance this month
davomat.employee.scans.title: Scans at the terminals
davomat.employee.scans.emptyToday: When they come to a terminal, the scan shows here with its photo.
davomat.employee.telegram.title: Telegram
davomat.employee.telegram.linkedBody: Linked: they get their own arrivals and departures from the organization’s bot.
davomat.employee.telegram.notLinkedBody: Not linked yet. Give them a one-time link: they open it, press Start in the bot, and they’re linked.
davomat.employee.telegram.create: Get a link with a QR code
davomat.employee.telegram.scanHint: Let them scan this with the phone’s camera, or send them the link.
davomat.employee.telegram.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.
davomat.employee.telegram.failed: Couldn’t make a link. Check that the Telegram bot is connected in Settings.
davomat.employee.telegram.unlinkBody: The bot stops writing to them. They can be linked again with a new link.
davomat.departments.description: The groups your reports add up by. Who is in which one is set on each employee.
davomat.departments.empty.title: No departments yet
davomat.departments.empty.body: Add the parts of your organization (sales, warehouse, office…) to see attendance by each one.
davomat.departments.deleteBody: Its employees stay; they just won’t be in a department.
davomat.departments.head: Head: {name}
davomat.positions.description: The job titles your employees hold.
davomat.positions.empty.title: No positions yet
davomat.positions.empty.body: Add the job titles you use so the feed and reports show what each person does.
davomat.positions.deleteBody: A position someone still holds can’t be deleted; change their position first.
davomat.branches.description: Every location from one screen: people, who is in now and the terminals at each.
davomat.branches.name: Name
davomat.branches.closeBody: It leaves the lists and reports from today. Its history stays, and you can reopen it.
davomat.branches.empty.title: No locations yet
davomat.branches.empty.body: Add your branches, offices or sites to see who is at each one.
davomat.team.fromTerminalHint: A terminal added this person from a face it didn’t know: check the name and position.
davomat.team.photo.removing: The photo is removed when you save.
davomat.employee.fromTerminal.title: Added by a terminal
davomat.employee.fromTerminal.body: The terminal saw a face it didn’t know and made this employee from it, with the name it had on the device. Check the name, position and location.
